title: CNC turning of valve stems
description: CNC turning of valve stems capability for titanium components
thicknessRange: Up to 400 mm diameter x 1000 mm length
processDescription: CNC turning of titanium on multi-axis lathes produces cylindrical components with precision diameters and surface finishes. Live tooling enables milling and drilling in the same setup, specifically for valve. Precision valve for Oil & Gas, Chemical present unique challenges: Seat leakage Class VI (ANSI FCI 70-2) requires lapped sealing surfaces. Stem straightness ±0.02 mm over 500 mm.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-tool for chip breaking and heat evacuation.
flatnessControl: Steady rests for long slender parts. Stress-relieved stock recommended.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for CNC turning of valve stems, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
